question: Does the field SOP say anything about surveying snow-covered ground?
expectedAnswerPoints: Partial and honest about the gap: the published SOP has no snow clause; it may quote the coupling clause that exists and name the missing procedure in unknowns rather than inferring a rule.
forbiddenClaims: Must not infer a winter rule from other clauses or from practice; no claim that the SOP covers all ground conditions.
expectedSource: SYNTH-GPR-SOP-FIELD-11 page:9 section:3.4 (nearest clause; no snow provision in the published text)
